Subject: Recap: Discovery + procurement questions

Hi Jordan / Elena -

Thanks again for the time today - quick recap and next steps from our call: 

- Use case: internal search + customer-facing chat for Acme Support (demo looked good).
- Preferred go-live: Q3 pilot (small production workload).
- Primary asks from your side: procurement path (PO vs card), internal approvals mapping (who signs, who owns budget), and whether you prefer marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) vs direct SOW.

Questions for procurement team:
1) Do you require a PO and standard Acme terms, or can you transact on card for pilot-sized commitments?
2) Who will be the budget owner / economic buyer for this product?
3) Is the CFO or procurement signatory required for the pilot, or can a Finance sponsor approve?

Attached: initial quote (redwood-acme-quote-v1.pdf) and standard T&Cs. I also dropped in a short commercial path outline below (PO vs card vs marketplace) so we can map next steps.

Next steps I propose:
- Jordan/Procurement: confirm payment method and signatory path (reply by end of week).
- Acme: share contact for budget owner (name + email).
- Redwood: I'll prepare updated quote and list of required contracting docs once we confirm signatory.

Thanks -
Marissa

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + procurement questions

Hi Marissa -

Appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers from procurement: 

- Payment: For pilots under $50k we can usually pay by card or corporate AMEX; anything above that requires a PO and our standard procurement review.
- Marketplace: We prefer AWS Marketplace for annual contracts (easier billing & approvals), but for pilots we often do direct purchase to move faster.
- Signatory: For pilot-level spend our Finance sponsor can sign (Director-level); full contracts above our threshold will need CFO sign-off.

Budget owner: I'm not 100% sure - Elena (cc'd) is leading the AI initiative and should be the economic buyer. I'll let her confirm the budget owner and provide the direct contact for finance.

Happy to schedule a 15-min sync if you want to walk through our procurement checklist.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Product Manager | Acme Corp
jordan.smith@acme.com

Thanks - that's helpful. Elena, can you confirm the budget owner (name + email) and whether the Director of Finance (if different from signatory) will be the finance sponsor? Also, please let me know if Acme would prefer AWS Marketplace for the pilot or a direct purchase on card.

I've attached an updated quote (v2) that includes pilot pricing and an optional marketplace SKU (if you want to compare). If a PO is required, we'll prepare a standard SOW and the redwood subscriptions team will coordinate the PO-to-invoice flow.

I'll loop in our contracts lead if we need to negotiate terms, but from experience most pilots can proceed on our standard terms and a Director-level sign-off. Vivek - FYI on procurement path and potential marketplace interest.
